title: ملفات ضمان متناسبة
rule:
Applies when: When selecting assurance depth.
Use STANDARD by default, LITE only for eligible low-impact work, and CONTROLLED for protected/high-impact boundaries; profiles do not themselves grant actions.
rationale: اختيار ضمان غير مناسب قد يتجاهل حدوداً محمية. PROVISIONAL_OWNER_REVIEW
